title: A revert of a red main has no role that can push it: the builder cannot edit tests, so a revert that spans code and tests is blocked
why: Consultant message to triage 9, 18:22 CST Nov 16 (relayed, not read by triage 9): decision builders-cannot-edit-tests makes builder-diff refuse a builder's test edits, and rule git-red-main-reverts lets only the revert of the blamed commit merge on a red main, so no agent role can push a revert that touches both code and tests. Main was red at 18:10 CST on #3596's push run 43975053159 (private owner name in a template; fix on #3602's branch).
source: Consultant messages to triage 9, 18:22 CST and 18:24 CST Nov 16 (relayed; checked by triage 9 only for the push-run states read on REST at 18:24 CST). Filed by triage 9.
note: Todo. Name the role that may push a revert (or let a revert carry its test edits), as a guard or check change with review rounds. Note: the rail-jump test page.test.mjs:6253 failed once on #3543's push run 43973911859 (attempt 1) and passed on re-run (attempt 2, 18:20 CST), so it flakes; a fix lane runs on branch fix-rail-jump. No lane, no PR. 23:30 CST Nov 16: the workaround for #3596 is revert PR #3607 (draft, head 695ee9aeafc8, base e58efd90ae6c, clean, 6 files, read on REST by triage 9 at 23:30 CST), split by role: part 1 restores hooks/test_auto_mode_allow.py, part 2 the other five files. The revert is a workaround for this step, not its fix, so the step's pr field stays empty; the owner's item 931 was withdrawn and closed. [03:11 CST Nov 17, triage 9] Revert PR #3607 merged 03:07:11 CST Nov 17 as 5e9f66d64d47 (REST, coordinator relay and runner 10 word); main push run 44052619976 on it is success (coordinator relay, REST 03:07 CST; not read by triage 9). Runner 10 merged it with merge 3607 --confirm --head <live head> --base-red-ok, started 03:05:49 CST, so the merge path never hit guard records-page-ready. Open gap, unmeasured: whether a stand-alone ready mark on a PR should refuse when stamp.json holds none; the refusing guard code was not found by the coordinator or triage. Page items 931 and 933 closed.
